title: Broaden delegated capability live coverage
summary: Capability enforcement is broad, but live coverage should keep expanding around scoped delegated paths where production mutation boundaries depend on dispatch-time allowlists.
expectedFailureModes: Delegated mutation paths pass unit tests but fail real daemon/CLI authorization flow.
Live coverage metadata does not name the capability namespace being enforced.
Allowlist tests cover positive paths but omit scoped denial evidence.
nextAction: Add one delegated live coverage slice for a scoped mutation namespace, including denial and allowed-path evidence in live coverage metadata.
